name: copeland_catalogue_correlation
title: ARI/Copeland catalogue polynomial for scroll compressors (function library)
summary: FUNCTION copeland_ari(table$, coef$, T_ev, T_cd): ARI 10-coefficient third-order polynomial of a Copeland ZH scroll compressor catalogue (power W, mass flow M, swept volume Vs), with the five catalogue tables recovered from the source file; the compressor correlation of the Vitocal 300-G heat pump model CSL-0116.

verification.reference: EES stored solution of the source file for the property states (T_ev, T_cd, T_su_cp, v_su_cp within 0.03 %, h_su_cp shifted by the 148.16 kJ/kg R134a reference-state offset) and exactness self-checks for the function (W_err = 0; M polynomial recomputed in Python from the shipped tables). The catalogue-dependent outputs are not comparable: the stored run used an older external version of the ZH38K4E-TFD table (Vs = 82.61 cm^3, factor 3-4 in W) that is absent from the collection. Comparison run on the runnable variant.
verification.notes: T_ev rel. diff 2.9e-2 as printed by compare_solution.py (0.019 K absolute on a 0.65 C saturation temperature); h_su_cp differs by the documented reference-state offset; W_dot/M_dot/Vs/epsilon_v differ by the documented catalogue vintage.

history.action: added (function library; catalogue tables hand-decoded from the binary; native file blocked by CS-BUG-LOOKUP-COL-ARG, verified runnable variant copeland_catalogue_correlation_coolsolve.eescode)
